in_arabic.name: قريش
in_arabic.meaning: اسم قبيلة النبي محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم
in_arabic.long_meaning: قريش هي قبيلة النبي محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم، وتعني القبيلة التي تفتخر بنسبها وكرمها، واسم قريش مشتق من قورش أي تجمع وتؤلف بين القبائل، وهو أيضاً اسم لسورة في القرآن الكريم

in_urdu.name: قریش

in_urdu.long_meaning: قریش نبی محمد صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم کی قبیلہ کا نام ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے ایک ایسا گروہ جو اپنے نسب اور شرافت پر فخر کرتا ہے، یہ نام عربی زبان کے 'قورش' سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے قبائل کے درمیان اتحاد اور میل جول، اور یہ سورة قرآن کا بھی نام ہے

data.cultural_impact: The name "Quraish" signifies a proud and esteemed Arab tribe mentioned numerous times in Islamic history and tradition. They were a major authority and power in the city of Mecca before the advent of Islam, and their influence extended far beyond their own city. The term "Quraish" has come to represent a mark of distinction and nobility in the Islamic world.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic tradition, the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) was born into the noble and distinguished tribe of Quraish, making it a source of immense spiritual significance. The Prophet's lineage and connection to this revered tribe played an important role in the spread of Islam, as many of his followers came from among its members. The spiritual significance of the name "Quraish" lies in its association with the Prophet (pbuh) and the early Islamic community, and the connection it represents to the holy cities of Mecca and Medina.
